normative_extracts.quote: Flow-relative properties resolve to physical properties during computed-value resolution based on the element’s writing-mode and direction.

browser_support.notes: Core inline/block properties shipped earlier; inset and border-start-start-radius reached full parity by 2021.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Engine maps inline-start/end and block-start/end to physical top/right/bottom/left based on direction (ltr/rtl) and writing-mode.

production_failures.symptom: Arabic/Hebrew (dir="rtl") layout renders icons and borders on the wrong side
production_failures.root_cause: Stylesheet hardcodes margin-left, border-left, and text-align: left instead of logical equivalents.
production_failures.mitigation: Replace physical left/right with inline-start/inline-end and text-align: start.

production_failures.symptom: Overriding margin-inline with margin-left fails unexpectedly
production_failures.root_cause: Physical and logical properties share the same underlying computed slots; specificity and source order decide the winner.
production_failures.mitigation: Standardize on logical properties across the entire codebase rather than mixing physical and logical.
